## Why this notebook exists

Unit tests cover construction and small synthetic recovery. This notebook probes
**larger** nested DGPs, hierarchical DAG unrolling for `identify`, and the
hand-off to CausalTargeted cluster-robust MSM (same point estimates; sandwich Σ).

Out of scope: MixedModels / BLUP fitting (application layer only; see
`examples/hierarchical_mixedmodels_concordance.md`).

## Generative nest: within-cluster dependence and ATE

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-nested-ate
#| warning: false

cols, truth = simulate_hierarchical_intercept_ate(
    1500; n_clusters = 50, σ_cluster = 1.25, β_a = 0.5, σ_y = 0.35,
    rng = MersenneTwister(41),
)
Y = cols[:Y]; A = cols[:A]; W = cols[:W]; C = cols[:cluster]
X = [ones(length(Y)) A W]
ate_hat = (X \ Y)[2]
@assert abs(ate_hat - truth.ate) < 0.06
# Residual within-cluster products should track σ_cluster²
Y_res = Y .- truth.ate .* A .- truth.β_w .* W
function mean_within_product(y, c)
    s = 0.0; n_pairs = 0
    for i in eachindex(y), j in (i + 1):length(y)
        if c[i] == c[j]
            s += y[i] * y[j]
            n_pairs += 1
        end
    end
    return n_pairs == 0 ? 0.0 : s / n_pairs
end
ρ = mean_within_product(Y_res, C)
@assert ρ > 0.5
(ate_hat, truth.ate, ρ, truth.σ_cluster^2)
```

## Hierarchical DAG unroll → identify

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-unroll-identify
#| warning: false

spec = HierarchicalNestingSpec(
    [:W, :A, :Y],
    [(:W, :A), (:W, :Y), (:A, :Y)];
    cluster_variable = :U,
    affects = [:Y],
)
un = unroll_hierarchical_dag(spec, 6; n_clusters = 3)
@assert nv(un.graph) == 3 + 6 * 3
A1 = hierarchical_node(un, (:unit, 1, :A))
Y1 = hierarchical_node(un, (:unit, 1, :Y))
id = attach_hierarchy_assumptions(identify(un.graph, TotalEffectQuery(A1, Y1)))
@assert id.identifiable
@assert :nested_exogenous in id.assumptions
(nv(un.graph), id.strategy, id.assumptions)
```

## Targeted MSM: unit vs cluster sandwich

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-msm-cluster
#| warning: false

df, _ = simulate_repeated_outcome_ate(
    800; T = 3, β_a = [0.2, 0.5, 0.35], rng = StableRNG(42),
)
df.cluster = Float64.(mod1.(1:nrow(df), 25))
rng_u = StableRNG(43)
u_by = Dict{Float64, Float64}(c => randn(rng_u) for c in unique(df.cluster))
uv = [u_by[c] for c in df.cluster]
for y in (:Y1, :Y2, :Y3)
    df[!, y] = df[!, y] .+ uv
end
res_u = run_repeated_outcome_msm(
    df, :A, [:Y1, :Y2, :Y3];
    baseline = [:W], folds = 3, learners = (:glm, :mean), rng = StableRNG(44),
)
res_c = run_repeated_outcome_msm(
    df, :A, [:Y1, :Y2, :Y3];
    baseline = [:W], folds = 3, learners = (:glm, :mean), rng = StableRNG(44),
    cluster = :cluster,
)
@assert res_c.estimates ≈ res_u.estimates atol = 1e-12
@assert res_c.covariance_kind === :cluster
@assert res_c.covariance ≉ res_u.covariance
@assert all(isfinite, res_c.se)
(res_u.se, res_c.se, maximum(abs.(res_c.estimates .- [0.2, 0.5, 0.35])))
```

## Ledger

| Probe | Gate |
|-------|------|
| Nested ATE recovery | `|ate_hat - 0.5| < 0.06` |
| Within-cluster residual product | `ρ > 0.5` |
| Unroll + identify | identifiable + hierarchy assumptions |
| MSM cluster sandwich | same τ̂; Σ_cluster ≠ Σ_unit; finite SEs |
